elements.name: localization.message
elements.brief: create a message pattern for a localization key defined in an .editor_localization file; the actual localization happens when the returned value is stringified
elements.description: Create a message pattern for a localization key defined in an .editor_localization file; the actual localization happens when the returned value is stringified

returnvalues.name: message
returnvalues.doc: a userdata value that, when stringified with tostring(), will produce a localized text according to the currently selected language in the editor

parameters.name: key
parameters.doc: localization key defined in an .editor_localization file

parameters.name: vars
parameters.doc: optional table with variables to be substituted in the localized string that uses ICU Message Format syntax; keys must be strings; values must be either nil, boolean, number, string, or another message instance

elements.name: localization.and_list
elements.brief: create a message pattern that renders a list with the "and" conjunction (for example: a, b, and c) once it is stringified
elements.description: Create a message pattern that renders a list with the "and" conjunction (for example: a, b, and c) once it is stringified

returnvalues.name: message
returnvalues.doc: a userdata value that, when stringified with tostring(), will produce a localized text according to the currently selected language in the editor

parameters.name: items
parameters.doc: ] array of values; each value may be nil, boolean, number, string, or another message instance

elements.name: localization.or_list
elements.brief: create a message pattern that renders a list with the "or" conjunction (for example: a, b, or c) once it is stringified
elements.description: Create a message pattern that renders a list with the "or" conjunction (for example: a, b, or c) once it is stringified

returnvalues.name: message
returnvalues.doc: a userdata value that, when stringified with tostring(), will produce a localized text according to the currently selected language in the editor

parameters.name: items
parameters.doc: ] array of values; each value may be nil, boolean, number, string, or another message instance

elements.name: localization.concat
elements.brief: create a message pattern that concatenates values (similar to table.concat) and performs the actual concatenation when stringified
elements.description: Create a message pattern that concatenates values (similar to table.concat) and performs the actual concatenation when stringified

returnvalues.name: message
returnvalues.doc: a userdata value that, when stringified with tostring(), will produce a localized text according to the currently selected language in the editor

parameters.name: items
parameters.doc: ] array of values; each value may be nil, boolean, number, string, or another message instance

parameters.name: separator
parameters.doc: optional separator inserted between values; defaults to an empty string
